Four photos. One journey. And a smile that says so much. ❤️

In her first photo, the signs of aging were clearly visible.

Deep lines around her eyes, sagging cheeks, and loose skin along her lower face made her features appear heavier and more tired.

Then came the part most people don’t see.

The bandages. The swelling. The bruising around her eyes.

Recovery isn’t always pretty, and it doesn’t happen overnight.

But look at the difference between the first and last photos. ✨

Her cheeks appear more supported, the lines around her mouth look softer, and her jawline has a smoother, more defined contour.

And that final smile?

It’s my favorite part of this transformation.

With Tri-Vector Lift™, my goal is never to create a completely different face.

It’s to restore support to the aging facial tissues, improve natural contours, and preserve the features that make each patient unique.

A refreshed face. A familiar smile. Still completely herself.

— Dr. Ye

#TriVectorLift #FaceliftTransformation #NaturalFacelift #FacialRejuvenation #faceliftrecovery
